title: Routine recall that is almost entirely small talk

transcript.text: We closed on Friday! The kitchen needs work but we love it.

transcript.speaker: HYGIENIST
transcript.text: That's so exciting. Are you doing the remodel yourselves?

transcript.text: My husband thinks he can. We'll see. He watched a lot of YouTube.

transcript.speaker: HYGIENIST
transcript.text: Okay, cleaning is done, everything looks healthy, no bleeding.
